plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Chemistry, Associate of Science' program page (Major Code: 2001S), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/catalog/engineering-physical-and-computer-sciences-department/chemistry/chemistry-associate-of-science . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the four 'Fall/Spring Semester Freshman/Sophomore Year' tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals). TRUE award: Associate of Science. Total credits: 63, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 63'); semester totals 16/15/17/15 sum exactly. Choice slots: WELL GE / HUMA GE / SOCS GE / COMM GE / HUMA GE2 / SOCS GE2 are official catalog placeholders for 'any Gen. Ed.' course in that category (student choice); PROG ELEC rows are 'Program Electives' (4 credits each semester; student choice from the program-electives list printed on the page: BIOL 201, CHEM 253, CHEM 299, MATH 175, MATH 275, PHYS 212). Spring Sophomore: official 'CHEM 299 Organic Chemistry 2* (5) OR CHEM 253 Quantitative Analysis* (5)' - modeled as one 5-credit choice slot. Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page. Footnotes: Humanities and Social Science courses must each be from 2 different disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.'
